contentHtml:
Preparing a proper landscape design plan is a must if you want to enhance your outdoor spaces. With this, you can save time and money and also ensure the result is exactly what you have been wanting.

In this article, we are going to explore more about the components and benefits of a landscape design plan. In addition, you will see its future trends and which steps you need to follow to create it.

Future Trends in Landscape Design Plans

Whether it is for an elegant villa in Dubai, or the outdoor spaces of an apartment, a landscape design can create a beautiful area that reflects the luxury of the Dubai lifestyle.

However, most people look for a natural escape when it comes to their gardens, and they decide to opt for a green living. In the past years, landscape design has had a striking transformation that is shaping the focus on outdoor spaces.

The following are some of the future trends we expect to see when it comes to preparing a landscape design plan:

  • Sustainability: eco-awareness is becoming the centre of many design projects. One of the future trends is to minimize water use by adding native plants and species that can withstand drought. This way, the place will look amazing without having to waste water by following the biophilic trends in the UAE.
  • Desert scenery: given the unique beauty of Dubai, many homeowners are considering to implement desert-inspired gardens. Thus, you can see many elements like sand, rocks and native plants.
  • Outdoor living spaces: one of the expected trends is to see indoor spaces replicated in the outdoors. For instance, outdoor kitchens or outdoor seating areas.
  • Vertical gardens: when it comes to overcoming space limitations, vertical gardens are a great choice. By installing green walls, you can improve the aesthetic of the space and a touch of natural beauty.
  • Smart technology: given the constant advancement of technology, it is expected to see more systems installed in outdoor spaces. For instance, lighting systems, smart irrigation to save water, and even robotic lawnmowers.

Benefits of a Landscape Design Plan

Just like when you are remodelling the interior architecture of your home you would need a plan, for redesigning your garden you also need a plan.

A landscape design plan is a way to give proper attention to all the details and elements you are considering adding. However, making a plan has more benefits than just refreshing the look of your outdoors.

The following are the additional benefits of making your landscape design plan:

  • It helps you visualize your design ideas and make the best decisions.
  • Allows you to create a space that allows you to connect with nature right at your home.
  • By considering including native plants you are also protecting natural resources.
  • It helps you use the area most prominently and take advantage of every corner of your outdoors.
  • It decreases the likelihood of committing errors
  • By taking into account the proper dimensions, you can wisely and carefully select the perfect objects you will add to your outdoors.
  • It increases the value of your property, which is good if you are planning to rent it or sell it to obtain profit.
  • With a good design, you and your family can enjoy time together and dwell in the natural habitat of Dubai.
  • It is perfect for allowing your pets to have an extra space where they can roam around. Also, it is great for children as they have more space to play.

Keep in mind that to obtain all of these benefits, you need to partner with a great service provider. For this reason, you need to know how to choose the right construction company.

Components of a Landscape Design Plan

Before starting with landscape design planning, you have to take into account all of its components. Thus, this means you have to consider the following:

  • Land: since you will be making the plan for your outdoors, you need to know the space. Learn about different factors, such as topography and climate, as well as the type of soil. This will help you determine which elements and materials you can use, and how to protect them.
  • End-user: Another important component is the end-user. For instance, if you are an elderly couple, you may want to add relaxing areas. Or, if you have little children, you should consider security factors. If you are a young couple, you may want to gather with friends, and as such you such add sharing spaces.
  • Theme: the theme you want to implement is also a key component. Some of the common themes are desert, contemporary, rock garden, etc.
  • Materials: choose the materials like grass, flowers, plants, furniture, and many others according to the theme.
  • Plants: plants are a key component as they give life to the design. In this regard, considering weather and soil, you have to choose plants that will thrive on your land.

Consider also how to plan the outdoor lighting as it is a crucial component for ensuring the place looks great even during the night.

Steps to Create a Landscape Design Plan

Creating a landscape design plan is not an easy task. However, if you want to simplify it, you have to follow the proper steps to achieve great results.

The design process is the following:

  1. Measure your property to create the outline. You should know precisely the area in which you are going to make the design to choose the hardscape and components.
  2. Add the existing features and the ornamental edges, as well as the building or house, poles, slopes, and any other. These features are those you cannot move. Consider also the sun and shades to plan accordingly.
  3. Next, consider the moveable parts of your landscape. These are known as hardscapes and can be pavers, stones, rocks, decks, walls, driveways, and more.
  4. Now, you have to think about garden beds and walking lawns as they add an aesthetic to the place. Thus, you have to consider which are the more relevant areas to add them.
  5. Consider now elements like form, colour, texture, and scale to create the perfect balance between all the elements.
  6. Find the spots for the shrubs and trees. Thus, you have to consider the space you have available. Keep in mind not to exceed with them as it can make your outdoors too overwhelming.

Once you have a plan, you need to review it constantly so you can determine if the elements you have chosen actually work or if you should make changes.

An innovative architecture firm can provide the support you need when it comes to creating your design plan.

Tips for DIY Landscape Design Planning

If you want to make your landscape design plan, you need to take into account several aspects to succeed. Consider following the next tips:

  • Use an app or software for landscape design plans so it can be easier for you. These programs help you design easily, particularly if you do not have any experience.
  • Use a measuring tape to measure your property and to obtain accurate measurements.
  • Review your building plans if you do not know how to measure your land, as they have details about the outdoor space.
  • Take pictures of your property to have with you when you are preparing the plan
  • Consider requesting feedback from an architect to receive a second opinion about whether something will work or not.
  • Keep in mind that your design plan may change as you work on it.

FAQs for Landscape Design Plans

What is the planning process for landscape design?

Analyze the site, define needs, sketch ideas, make a conceptual plan, then create the final design.

How do I create a landscape layout?

Make a base map, mark fixed features, and sketch ideas on paper or design software.

What elements should be included in a landscape design plan?

Colours, lines, shapes, size, and a balance of softscape and hardscape.

Can I DIY my landscape design plan, or should I hire a professional?

DIY works for small budgets; a professional ensures higher quality and detail.

How do I choose the right plants for my landscape design plan?

Match plants to site conditions, style, and maintenance needs; prefer native species.

What factors should I consider when designing a functional outdoor space?

Divide spaces, add functional elements, ensure good lighting, and connect indoors with outdoors.
